_: GutLog v3.31.0 -- a food library by weight with a sourced table, and a time on every entry. v3.30.0 has no weights, no table, no time on the meal card and no time buttons, so a version control fails most of these -- and says little about the ones that guard a PROPERTY. Those are also broken on purpose in the current build: the migration writing to meals, a household measure passed off as exact, the page's numbers trusted for a weighed item, a dry weight not marked, his value reverted to a table's or to 'estimated', a changed number passed off as USDA, a retime that leaves the day where it was, a future meal time accepted, a card time change left unrecorded, the per-100 line gone from the list, the dry label gone from the basket, a past-day row saving onto today, the card ignoring the time chosen, the editor never filling from the table, and a weight field too wide for the folded screen. 02 has no version control at all: v3.30.0 has no migration, so it cannot fail it.
